remarks: Welcome to the sweetest cottage in Westport! Built in 1947, it has all the charming details, and yet, is also renovated so it has all the modern conveniences. The best of both worlds! It has three bedrooms (sizable too!) and two full baths. The open floor plan has gorgeous hardwoods throughout. The one car garage is connected to the house by a covered breezeway. Pull your car into the garage and unload your groceries while totally covered from the weather. This sweet creampuff sits on almost a half acre. The backyard is sunny, flat and fully fenced in. The front yard sits well up off the street so as to be convenient, yet quiet too. The house has many upgrades which are detailed in the listing documents. The cottage is wired for a portable generator and a portable generator comes with the house. A sweet cottage that is both charming and solid! Come take a look.
